subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We would like to inform you that there has been a change in your flight reservation for your upcoming trip to Paris. The departure time has been rescheduled to accommodate unforeseen circumstances. Please review the updated details in your booking confirmation email. If you have any concerns or need further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you. Best regards, Airline Customer Service
